shortDescription: Manage cluster related operations on PowerStore

options.name: appliance_id
options.description: ID of the appliance. Parameters I(appliance_id) and I(appliance_name) are mutually exclusive. Parameter I(is_ssh_enabled) has to be passed along with I(appliance_id).

options.name: appliance_name
options.description: Name of the appliance. Parameters I(appliance_id) and I(appliance_name) are mutually exclusive. Parameter I(is_ssh_enabled) has to be passed along with I(appliance_name).

options.name: appliances
options.description: Appliance configuration setting during cluster creation. This is mandatory for create cluster operation.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: chap_mode
options.description: The mode that describes or sets the iSCSI CHAP mode for the cluster.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Id of the cluster.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The Name of cluster.

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: DNS server addresses in IPv4 format. At least one DNS server should be provided. This is mandatory for create cluster operation.

options.name: ignore_network_warnings
options.description: Whether to ignore the network warning about unreachable external network.

options.name: is_http_redirect_enabled
options.description: Whether to redirect the HTTP requests to HTTPS.

options.name: is_ssh_enabled
options.description: Whether SSH access is enabled for the cluster. Either I(appliance_id) or I(appliance_name) is to be passed along with I(is_ssh_enabled).

options.name: networks
options.description: Configuration of one or more network(s) based on network type. This is mandatory for create cluster operation.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name for the cluster.

options.name: ntp_servers
options.description: NTP server addresses in IPv4 or hostname format. At least one NTP server should be provided. This is mandatory for create cluster operation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: physical_mtu
options.description: MTU for ethernet ports in the cluster. The MTU can be set between 1500 to 9000.

options.name: physical_switches
options.description: Physical switch setting for a new cluster.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: service_password
options.description: The password for the service user.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the cluster should exist or not. Value C(present) indicates that the cluster should exist on the system. Value C(absent) indicates that the cluster should not exist on the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: validate_create
options.description: Whether to perform create cluster validate call.

options.name: vcenters
options.description: Configure vCenter settings when creating cluster. Currently, for vcenters parameter API supports only single element. This is required when creating PowerStore X cluster and optional for PowerStore T.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Flag to indicate if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. C(true) signifies synchronous execution. By default, create cluster operation will run asynchronously.
